declared_purpose: Generate and email a daily report of popular Bilibili videos, including statistics and optional subtitle-based AI summaries, commentary and popularity analysis. The entry explicitly offers disabling AI; credential collection and storage are prescribed workflow choices, not inherent requirements of reporting or delivery (SKILL.md:1-7, 32-107, 129-137; README.md:31-39).

data_operations.operation: Collect credentials and delivery settings through the agent conversation
data_operations.data_scope: Full Bilibili Cookie string; optional OpenRouter API key and model; Gmail sender address, application password and recipient addresses
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: The executing agent's conversation and named workflow variables
data_operations.condition: Configuration is absent; OpenRouter credentials are requested only when AI is selected. Email settings are requested unconditionally in this setup path.

data_operations.data_scope: Bilibili cookies, OpenRouter key, model, SMTP address and password, recipients and video count
data_operations.condition: First-use setup reaches configuration creation. A Git ignore rule excludes this filename; it does not encrypt or delete it.

data_operations.operation: Read local configuration, credentials and email inputs
data_operations.source: CLI arguments, environment variables, configuration JSON and optional subject/body files
data_operations.data_scope: The report generator loads the entire shared configuration, including email settings; the sender also loads the entire configuration, including Bilibili and AI settings. Each component then selects its relevant values. The sender reads the complete selected body file.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process memory in generate_report.py and send_email.py
data_operations.condition: Corresponding inputs are supplied. Credential precedence is CLI, environment, then configuration. No remote forwarding of the complete configuration is shown.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve popular videos and conditional video details
data_operations.source: Parsed Bilibili cookies and report settings
data_operations.data_scope: All supplied cookies, or selected individual cookie fields; page number and requested video count; BV identifier when details are needed. Responses provide video metadata and statistics to the local caller.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: api.bilibili.com at /x/web-interface/popular and conditionally /x/web-interface/view; cookies are scoped to .bilibili.com in the session
data_operations.condition: Normal report generation requires SESSDATA in main(). Details are fetched when subtitle lookup lacks aid or cid. CLI defaults request 20 videos and override a configured count when --num-videos is omitted.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve subtitle metadata and download one subtitle
data_operations.source: Popular-video identifiers and Bilibili's subtitle metadata response
data_operations.data_scope: aid and cid, session cookies for matching Bilibili domains, then the selected subtitle URL; downloaded timestamped text is converted into complete plain text in memory
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: api.bilibili.com/x/player/wbi/v2, then the host named by subtitle_url; results remain with the local caller
data_operations.condition: Attempted for every returned video, including when AI is disabled. Chinese subtitles are preferred, otherwise the first subtitle is selected. Cookies on the session download remain domain-scoped; disclosure to an arbitrary nonmatching subtitle host is not established.

data_operations.operation: Disclose subtitle content for AI summarization
data_operations.source: Video title and locally downloaded subtitle text
data_operations.data_scope: Title and up to 8,000 subtitle characters, with an ellipsis after truncation; selected model and OpenRouter API key for authentication
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions; downstream provider handling is undocumented in the supplied source
data_operations.condition: A subtitle and OpenRouter key are both present. Handled failures can cause up to three attempts. Returned summary and outline are processed locally.

data_operations.operation: Disclose video metrics and a generated summary for AI commentary
data_operations.source: Collected video statistics and optional generated summary
data_operations.data_scope: Title, views, likes, favorites, coins, comment and danmaku counts, shares, calculated like rate and summary; model and authentication key
data_operations.condition: An OpenRouter key is present, even if no subtitle summary was available. This separate call produces the requested commentary and popularity analysis.

data_operations.operation: Derive analysis and assemble report content
data_operations.source: Video metadata, aggregate engagement statistics and model responses
data_operations.data_scope: Calculated engagement ratios, popularity labels and content tags; AI summaries and inferred popularity factors; creator display names, publication times, statistics, links and descriptions limited to 500 characters
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local report string returned to its caller
data_operations.condition: Report generation. These are content and engagement analyses; the source does not establish profiling of the authenticated user's interests.

data_operations.operation: Write or display the report and processing logs
data_operations.data_scope: Complete Markdown report; progress can include shortened video titles, configuration/output paths and model name
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Specified local output file, or stdout if no output is supplied; the entry workflow uses /tmp/bilibili_report.md and directs the agent to forward actual progress output
data_operations.condition: Successful generation. No report deletion step is shown in the generation-and-email workflow.

data_operations.operation: Authenticate and transmit the report by email
data_operations.source: Sender credentials, selected recipients, subject and supplied report body
data_operations.data_scope: SMTP address and application password for login; sender, all recipient addresses, subject and complete text or converted HTML body for delivery
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Selected SMTP server, defaulting to smtp.gmail.com:587 in the CLI, followed by the selected mail recipients. Every recipient appears in the shared To header.
data_operations.condition: Email sending is invoked and credentials are available. The implementation starts TLS before authentication and submission. SMTP/provider mailbox retention is unspecified.

data_operations.source: Resolved recipient list and SMTP execution
data_operations.data_scope: Full recipient addresses, SMTP host/port, success counts and exception text
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: stdout of send_email.py and its caller; further log storage or forwarding is not specified
data_operations.condition: The CLI prints recipients before sending; the helper prints each address during delivery.

data_operations.operation: Run standalone Bilibili API utility paths
data_operations.source: Utility CLI cookie arguments, action and BV identifier
data_operations.data_scope: Configured cookies and video identifiers; the legacy summary action additionally sends cid, uploader mid, web_location, timestamp and WBI signature, fetching and caching signing keys first. Selected results are printed.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Bilibili popular, view, nav and /x/web-interface/view/conclusion/get endpoints; local stdout and in-memory signing-key cache
data_operations.condition: bilibili_api.py is invoked directly with the relevant action. The current report generator uses the subtitle/OpenRouter path and does not call this official-summary method.

data_operations.source: Provided or default video URL and optional SESSDATA argument
data_operations.data_scope: BV identifier for an unauthenticated video-info request; aid, cid and optional SESSDATA for subtitle metadata; selected subtitle download without an explicit cookie argument. URL, identifiers, title and complete timestamped/plain subtitles are printed.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Bilibili view/player endpoints, the returned subtitle URL host, stdout and the function's caller
data_operations.condition: bilibili_subtitle.py is invoked directly or its functions are called. It is separate from the report generator's BilibiliAPI subtitle implementation.

data_operations.operation: Distribute a static example report with the package
data_operations.data_scope: Creator handles, video links, statistics, descriptions and attributed AI analyses; one linked creator's example includes financial, family and health-related assertions
data_operations.condition: Static sample distribution, independent of executing the skill. Its historical official-summary and Claude labels do not prove use of those paths by the current generator or establish the assertions' accuracy.

potential_excess.data_scope: Bilibili cookies, OpenRouter API key and SMTP application password
potential_excess.condition: The entry asks users to reply with credentials.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The entry explicitly prescribes these prompts, but reporting and email delivery require usable credentials rather than their inclusion in conversation.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Make the required credentials available to the appropriate local components.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Have users configure credentials locally through supported environment variables; collect model and recipient preferences separately.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Validate credential availability without displaying values; retain optional AI and authenticated email behavior.

potential_excess.data_scope: Bilibili cookies, OpenRouter key and SMTP password stored together
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Plaintext bilibili-monitor.json; both scripts subsequently load the entire file into local memory
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The entry explicitly requires this file creation, while the implementation also supports credentials from the environment. Persistent plaintext secrets are a workflow choice.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retain reporting preferences and provide each component its own credentials.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Keep secrets outside the JSON configuration and separate component-specific inputs; retain model, recipient and report preferences as needed.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Supply credentials through supported local mechanisms on each run. Git exclusion alone is insufficient to provide confidentiality.

potential_excess.data_scope: Every cookie in the copied browser Cookie header
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: BilibiliAPI's .bilibili.com cookie jar and matching Bilibili request destinations
potential_excess.condition: Full-cookie input is used. All parsed fields are installed, rather than only selected authentication fields.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Popular-video and subtitle access may require authentication; the supplied source does not establish that every browser cookie is necessary.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Authenticate only requests that need it and retain successful subtitle access.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Validate a minimal cookie allowlist and scope credentials to the endpoints that require them. This narrows data in required requests rather than removing those requests.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Endpoint authentication requirements remain unresolved. The separate utility demonstrates SESSDATA-only subtitle metadata requests, but does not prove compatibility for every report request.

potential_excess.data_scope: Subtitle metadata and complete subtitle downloads, plus conditional video-detail lookups
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Bilibili API and selected subtitle hosts; downloaded content in report-process memory
potential_excess.condition: No OpenRouter key is available, including the user-selected AI-disabled path.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Subtitles support AI summaries. Without a key, the retrieved subtitle text is not used to produce the report.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Generate the metadata/statistics report without AI summaries or commentary.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Skip subtitle retrieval when AI summarization is disabled. These are redundant actions on that path, rather than extra fields in a necessary action.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Continue fetching subtitles when summaries are enabled; keep metadata-only reporting functional.

potential_excess.data_scope: Videos beyond the configured count, with their metadata, subtitles, AI inputs and report entries
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Bilibili list/subtitle endpoints, OpenRouter when enabled, local report output and email recipients
potential_excess.condition: --num-videos is omitted while configuration specifies 10: argparse supplies 20, so the configuration fallback is bypassed.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The entry and example configure a 10-video report. The CLI default changes that scope.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Process the configured number unless the user explicitly overrides it.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use an unset CLI default, then resolve the explicit argument, configured count and final default in order.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve explicit CLI overrides. This reduces records in the list request and subsequent per-video actions, rather than removing the required list request.

potential_excess.data_scope: The complete list of recipient email addresses
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Each recipient's copy of the shared To header
potential_excess.condition: More than one recipient is configured.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Multi-recipient report delivery requires addressing each recipient, but does not require revealing the other addresses to them.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Deliver the same report to every selected recipient.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use separate messages or an envelope-only/Bcc recipient list.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Maintain delivery to every intended address and retain sender identity and report content.

potential_excess.data_scope: Full recipient addresses in routine delivery logs
potential_excess.condition: CLI recipient resolution and per-recipient sending logs
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Delivery status can be reported using counts without repeating contact details. Further log persistence or remote forwarding is unknown.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Report delivery progress, success and actionable errors.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Log recipient counts by default; expose masked or full addresses only for a deliberate diagnostic need.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep enough information to diagnose failed delivery without assuming stdout is itself an external disclosure.

potential_excess.data_scope: The generated Markdown report after email delivery
potential_excess.condition: The report is written for file-based email handoff; no cleanup step follows delivery in the supplied workflow.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The temporary file supports report generation and sending. Continued retention after successful delivery is not stated as a requirement.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Make the report available until delivery and any requested local retrieval are complete.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Delete the temporary handoff file after successful delivery unless the user requests an archive.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve files needed for failed-send retries or explicitly requested saved reports. Actual filesystem retention is unknown.

potential_excess.data_scope: A linked creator's financial, family and health-related assertions in the example
potential_excess.condition: Distribution of the static example report
potential_excess.purpose_basis: A report example demonstrates structure and analysis; identifiable sensitive narratives are unnecessary for that demonstration.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Show representative report sections, statistics and formatting.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use synthetic creators, links and narratives, or replace the sensitive example with neutral content.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve the report format and distinguish illustrative assertions from verified facts. This finding concerns the packaged sample, not an inference that the current workflow retrieved these details.

unknowns: The minimum cookies and authentication required by each Bilibili endpoint are not established; this blocks confirming the exact cookie reduction that preserves access.
Subtitle hosts are selected from runtime API responses. Their identities, access controls and retention practices are unresolved.

Bilibili, OpenRouter, downstream model providers, SMTP servers and recipient mail systems have undocumented retention, training, logging and deletion behavior. The source establishes requests and submissions, not those external practices.
The supplied package does not establish agent-conversation retention, credential-variable lifetime, stdout logging policy, configuration permissions or temporary-file cleanup by the host.

HTML conversion inserts source/model text without general HTML escaping (send_email.py:78-80, 135-148, 202-204). Mail-client rendering and external-resource fetching are unknown; no additional renderer-originated disclosure can be confirmed.
The static example's sensitive assertions are not independently verified, and its historical generation path cannot be reconstructed from its labels.
Only requests>=2.28.0 is specified (requirements.txt:1); dependency internals and the installed version were not supplied. No runtime or external behavior was verified in this source-only audit.
